luggage.title: Luggage storage service
luggage.p1: Before check-in, or after check-out, the building provides a luggage storage service for a value of 10 000 COP / piece for 24 hours. This service is not included in the rental fee of the apartment, and is provided directly by the building, not by us.
luggage.p2: Payment must be made at reception, through a QR code provided at the reception for people who have a Colombian bank account, or by credit or debit card for people who have a foreign bank account.
luggage.noCash: Cash payments are not accepted by the building administration.
